svg.title: 18650 pack - every wire, with lengths (2026-10-20)
svg.desc: Pack-side wiring of the autonomous car: 2S pack, BMS, fuse, charger, XT30, rocker, LM2596, TB6612, divider, motor + encoder, strips. Every wire is numbered W1-W17; the cut list gives its length. Solid = soldered as built; dashed = still to cut (estimates from the CAD, trim at the dry fit). Source: docs/WIRING_PROTOSHIELD.md section 2, docs/ELECTRONICS_LAYOUT.md, records IO-IW, JU-JW, KC.
svg.text: 18650 pack - every wire, with lengths (2026-10-20, tray v11 / deck v13)
Solid = soldered as built (length measured by Evan). Dashed = still to cut: estimate from the CAD, cut length in the list, trim at the dry fit. All wire 22 AWG.
Every ground wire lands on the STAR = the TB6612 GND pad on the shield (drawn as a bar: one pad, many wires). Grounds are never switched. Source: docs/WIRING_PROTOSHIELD.md section 2.
PROTO SHIELD on the Uno (deck, rear)
W4+W5 share the P+ pad, W6+W7 the P- pad
turn it so IN faces the
powered by the Pi's USB (JF), NOT the pack
D11 D8 D12 D10 -> TB6612, D2 D3 <- encoder
D4 D7 -> strips (via 400 ohm), A0 <- divider
5V -> TB6612 VCC + servo V+ (JR, NOT the pack)
+5V2 must NEVER touch the Uno 5V pin
W17 lengths: measure on the car
Tag = wire number + length in mm (cut length for dashed).
Nothing but the BMS touches B+ / MB / B- (unfused).
Encoder Vcc from +5V2 only, never VBAT.
Switch OFF = 0 V on VBAT; meter XT30 polarity (+8.x V) before any load.
The servo and the Uno are NOT on the pack (Pi USB, records JF / JR).
Lengths for dashed wires are CAD estimates - cut long, trim at the dry fit.
Holder red (CELL+) -> 3 A fuse -> BMS B+
measured by Evan (153 + 4 x 43.27); coil slack on the bank top
Holder brass rivet (series node) -> BMS MB
unfused - BMS sits at the rivet end of the holder top
over the bank top to the -y lobe
same route; tightest pack wire (~20-45 spare)
BMS P- -> charger GND (the one next to BAT)
over the bank top to the -y lobe
straight up to the rocker hanging under the wing
Rocker pin 2 -> shield VBAT pad -> TB6612 VM
up the power slot, along the deck, twisted with W12
on the shield; keeps the rocker tab to 2 wires
with W9 through the power slot
one leg for both; along the deck to the shield
+5V2 = 4.99 V; never to the Uno 5V pin
route ~220-270, ~30 spare (Evan); Dupont splice at the shield if short
+5V2 / DIN / GND to each strip segment
To buy / cut for step 2b and later (22 AWG): red ~480 mm (W8-W11), black ~560 mm (W12, W13, W15), orange ~120 mm (W14). Built so far: W1-W7 (pack), LM2596 set.
